baseline.name: Pattern matching on a virtual repeated string
baseline.approach: Run KMP over repeated source characters without materializing the whole repeat buffer.

archived.name: Materialize bounded repeats and call strstr
archived.time: O(a+b) copying plus two searches; conservative O((a+b)*b) with naive substring search

why: The repeat-count bound is useful, but the source delegates matching to strstr and does not establish a better bound than a linear pattern matcher.
quantitative_comparison: The archive makes at most two substring-search calls after constructing ceil(b/a) copies plus at most one extra. Those two calls do not imply linear search work or a speed advantage over KMP.
tradeoffs: Simpler implementation can help readability, while extra buffer storage and library-dependent search cost remain. Empty a divides by zero; integer sizes are constrained. SIMD behavior is not measured.
evidence_basis: Static work-bound comparison to a defined linear pattern-matching baseline; no libc-specific timing.
